title: AI Pencil Sketch Generator
summary: Make pencil sketches with AI: graphite shading, hatching and paper texture, from portraits to urban sketches. Describe it, pick a pencil style, and generate.
body_markdown:
### How do I make a pencil sketch with AI?


Describe the subject, the pencil grades, the shading and the paper, such as a graphite sketch of a man on a park bench with cross-hatched shadows on cream paper, then pick a pencil style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the sketch into a clip.


### Can AI turn a photo into a pencil sketch?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for a graphite pencil sketch of it, naming the shading and the paper and keeping the same pose and framing; the result redraws the photo in pencil.


### How do I make an AI sketch look hand drawn?


Ask for the flaws a real drawing has: visible construction lines, graphite smears, faint eraser marks, uneven pressure and edges that fade to bare paper. A perfectly even, fully shaded image reads as a filter rather than a sketch.


### Can I make a pencil sketch animation?


Yes. Generate the sketch first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe a small motion, such as the man turning a page, while asking to keep the graphite texture and paper.


### Is the pencil sketch generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
